long_biography.plain_text:
Dutch property investor Johan van den Bruele returned to development through a shopping-centre project in Aachen. After entering as a minority investor, he and Pim Kaufman bought out other participants and took responsibility for the scheme with architect Hans Kahlen. They planned to secure an institutional buyer before construction, limiting their exposure to a large, lengthy project.

Alongside the shopping centre, the partners acquired two office buildings for conversion into housing for older people, intended for their own portfolio. They also bought nearby retail properties. To work in the unfamiliar German market, they drew on Kahlen's local team and a retail specialist, Thomas Dörr.
